scope: Completed development decision, condensed from recorded hypotheses, source identities and outcomes. No unrecorded internal reasoning.
hypothesis: Move beyond time scaling. v1 rebuilds every machine arc for every neighbor and uses only dispatch-generated elites. v2 updates links only on the moved row, memoized DFS computes exact earliest starts with cycle detection and safe nonnegative tardiness partial-sum cutoffs, fixes aspiration ordering, randomizes machine traversal, and learns diverse local-search elites for restarts. Same weighted tardiness objective and tiny-flow tie break. Adaptation of generic critical-path tabu and elite diversification ideas, not a reproduction of published GRASP or shifting bottleneck. Equal-budget comparison to v1 at 300s on public inspected cases, then cross-seed confirmation.
decision_text:
v2 valid on all six cases including tiny2197. At equal300s seed0 one worker v2 improves every large case over v1: 30579 vs31807,29196 vs29340,30217 vs31041,30915 vs31467,26967 vs28252. It beats4/5 published references, missing large4 by513 (1.687%). Actual elapsed large cases299.869-299.893s; tiny300.446s includes setup. Compound evaluation supports combined changes only; cannot identify pruning versus diversification contribution. Best new record large2=29196, not best-known claim.
Next: Confirm frozen v2 at300s seed1 across all five cases, paired with prior v1 seed1. If broad improvement persists, extend v2 to1200s uniformly to target large4 and establish stronger all-five confirmation.
subsequent_decision_text:
v2 improves v1 on all five paired cases at300s seed1 as well as seed0, 10/10 paired wins across two seeds. All checks pass. Seed1 scores31078,28663,30190,30590,27501; three reference wins, remaining gaps large1+198 and large4+188. Actual elapsed299.857-299.915s. New best observed large2=28663, 10.192% belowreference. v2 evidence stronger than v1 short-run performance but stochastic sensitivity remains. No external best-known claim.
Next: Uniform1200s seed0 on frozen v2 across all five large cases to seek all-five wins with one budget/seed. Develop a standalone CP-SAT destroy-and-repair LNS as an independent stronger comparator, and resolve exact-instance literature comparison limits.
